visualCharacteristics.purpose: Plain page-title band (heading, optional intro text) without a photo backdrop, optionally with a link-list chooser, a collapsible notice panel or a side image

contentPattern.structure: one cell with the page heading and optional text, ticked lists and links. A list made only of links becomes a chooser button that reveals the list (the item for the current page, else the first, labels the button). With `cyan-2`, the first line is a header that collapses the rest. A picture-only cell becomes a side image

usage: Title bands on utility and content pages (64 pages heading-only), payments pages with a product chooser, 'Things you should know' notice panels, lifestage intro text.
reuseGuidance: Use when the page top is a heading band with no background photo. `cyan`/`cyan-2` record section colour treatments (`cyan-2` also adds the collapsible header panel); `image` signals a side image. Use hero-banner for copy over a photo.
